name: smith calf raise (with block)
description: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.
instructions: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
